titleEn: Law on the Establishment of Ministry of Social Affairs, Veteran and Youth Rehabilitation

articles.en: The Ministry of Social Affairs, Labour and Veterans is hereby established under the Royal Government of Cambodia.
The Ministry of Social Affairs, Labour and Veterans shall have the competence to lead and manage the social affairs sector, the labour sector and the veterans sector of the Kingdom of Cambodia.

The Ministry of Social Affairs, Labour and Veterans shall be led by one Minister or one Secretary of State, who may be assisted by Under-Secretaries of State as necessary.
Article 4: The organisational structure and functioning of the Ministry of Social Affairs, Labour and Veterans shall be determined by sub-decree.
Any provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.

This Law is declared to be urgent.
Done at Phnom Penh, 24 January 1996, and respectfully submitted for the Royal signature; Norodom Sihanouk; First Prime Minister, Second Prime Minister, Norodom Ranariddh, Hun Sen.
